Discover ALP 3mg Mixpack

Sample the full range of ALP's 3mg nicotine pouches with this mixpack, which includes five different cans—each representing one of the available flavors. Whether you lean toward mint varieties or prefer fruity options, this pack provides a selection to explore.

Each pouch delivers 3mg of nicotine, a less intense strength level. The pouches are moist, tobacco-free, and contain synthetic nicotine. Each can includes 20 pouches.
